rows.speaker: Raven
rows.en: Zeravire numbers are confirmed at 60 in this area, and 40 in the surrounding area.
rows.display_text:
「Zeravire numbers are confirmed at 60 in
this area, and 40 in the surrounding area.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Everyone, we must annihilate those 100 Zeravire.
rows.display_text:
「Everyone, we must annihilate those 100
Zeravire.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Operation time is 3 minutes! Take down all 100 Zeravire within that time!
rows.display_text:
「Operation time is 3 minutes! Take down
all 100 Zeravire within that time!」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Warriors! To protect this beautiful star, dance valiantly on your wings!!
rows.display_text:
「Warriors! To protect this beautiful
star, dance valiantly on your wings!!」

rows.speaker: Raven
rows.en: Enemy reinforcements! Twenty of them!
rows.display_text: 「Enemy reinforcements! Twenty of them!」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Not yet! Strike the enemy in front of you and lure every last one of them into this area!
rows.display_text:
「Not yet! Strike the enemy in front of
you and lure every last one of them into
this area!」

rows.speaker: Raven
rows.en: More reinforcements! Twenty of them!
rows.display_text: 「More reinforcements! Twenty of them!」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Good...! Now the enemy's core force has all gathered in this area.
rows.display_text:
「Good...! Now the enemy's core force has
all gathered in this area.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: All that's left is to defeat the enemy in front of us! Warriors, pour every ounce of your strength into this!
rows.display_text:
「All that's left is to defeat the enemy
in front of us! Warriors, pour every
ounce of your strength into this!」

rows.speaker: Raven
rows.en: Zeravire confirmed annihilated. Enemy forces in other regions have been mopped up as well, they report.
rows.display_text:
「Zeravire confirmed annihilated. Enemy
forces in other regions have been mopped
up as well, they report.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Well done, everyone. The beautiful souls and strength gathered here are what brought us victory...
rows.display_text:
「Well done, everyone. The beautiful souls
and strength gathered here are what
brought us victory...」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: As long as all of you are here, this star's peace will be protected... I'm proud to count myself among you.
rows.display_text:
「As long as all of you are here, this
star's peace will be protected... I'm proud
to count myself among you.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Thank you! You valiant, beautiful warriors!
rows.display_text:
「Thank you! You valiant, beautiful
warriors!」

rows.speaker: Raven
rows.en: Sandman! Two minutes have passed since the operation began! At this rate...
rows.display_text:
「Sandman! Two minutes have passed since
the operation began! At this rate...」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: I know. We have to settle this in the next minute!
rows.display_text:
「I know. We have to settle this in the
next minute!」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Everyone, your final strength! Burn everything you have in this one minute!
rows.display_text:
「Everyone, your final strength! Burn
everything you have in this one minute!」

rows.speaker: Raven
rows.en: Three minutes have passed since combat began! The operation's a failure!
rows.display_text:
「Three minutes have passed since combat
began! The operation's a failure!」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Dark clouds cover the world... Is this the beginning of Thanatos's age...?
rows.display_text:
「Dark clouds cover the world... Is this
the beginning of Thanatos's age...?」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: The Zeravire that survived are on a rampage!?
rows.display_text:
「The Zeravire that survived are on a
rampage!?」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Having lost Goma and with it all control, the Zeravire have become indiscriminate killing weapons.
rows.display_text:
「Having lost Goma and with it all
control, the Zeravire have become
indiscriminate killing weapons.」

rows.speaker: Mizuki
rows.en: But if Goma, the weapons plant, has been destroyed, doesn't that mean their numbers are limited?
rows.display_text:
「But if Goma, the weapons plant, has
been destroyed, doesn't that mean their
numbers are limited?」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: That's right. But it's exactly their numbers that are the problem.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. But it's exactly their
numbers that are the problem.」

rows.speaker: Eina
rows.en: Right now, the Zeravire army moving across the Siberian plains... their numbers are beyond counting.
rows.display_text:
「Right now, the Zeravire army moving
across the Siberian plains... their numbers
are beyond counting.」

rows.speaker: Luna
rows.en: To think that many Zeravire were still left...
rows.display_text:
「To think that many Zeravire were still
left...」

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: ...Let's go.
rows.display_text: 「...Let's go.」

rows.speaker: Leele
rows.en: Touga...
rows.display_text: 「Touga...」

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: No matter how vast the enemy's strength, we mustn't retreat.
rows.display_text:
「No matter how vast the enemy's
strength, we mustn't retreat.」

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: Fighting to the death for those without fangs -- that's our duty as Gran Knights.
rows.display_text:
「Fighting to the death for those without
fangs -- that's our duty as Gran
Knights.」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: Now that's quite something to say. Hearing you talk that big, I've got no choice but to make up my mind too.
rows.display_text:
「Now that's quite something to say.
Hearing you talk that big, I've got no
choice but to make up my mind too.」

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: Will you come with me, Eiji?
rows.display_text: 「Will you come with me, Eiji?」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: Don't ask something so obvious. There's nobody here who'd turn tail and run.
rows.display_text:
「Don't ask something so obvious. There's
nobody here who'd turn tail and run.」

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: Yeah.
rows.display_text: 「Yeah.」

rows.speaker: Raven
rows.en: Sandman, forces to fight the Zeravire have already gathered in Siberia from all over the world.
rows.display_text:
「Sandman, forces to fight the Zeravire
have already gathered in Siberia from all
over the world.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Then let's strike the core with one warship and five squads, and leave mopping up the surrounding enemy to the other units.
rows.display_text:
「Then let's strike the core with one
warship and five squads, leaving the
surrounding mop-up to the other units.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Gran Knights, move out! Crush that wicked power!
rows.display_text:
「Gran Knights, move out! Crush that
wicked power!」
